name: Medicine Query Report
query:
SELECT
    `name` AS "ID:Link/Medicine:120",
    `option` AS "Option:Data:100",
    `email_subject` AS "Email Subject:Data:200",
    `image` AS "Image:Attach Image:120",
    `my_email` AS "My Email:Data:180",
    `my_name` AS "My Name:Data:150"
FROM
    `tabMedicine`
WHERE
    `docstatus` != 2
ORDER BY
    `creation` DESC
